privacy_summary: Snapshot mode loads same-origin static release artifacts from painmaps.org. Live overlay mode is opt-in and may fetch documented public-source domains for current context rows; the client does not send user ids, precise location, personal-health fields, or typed search strings to those upstream sources.

modes.label: Snapshot
modes.trigger: Default page load and default atlas exploration
modes.cache_policy: Immutable release URLs are checksummed in the release manifest and can be replayed from committed artifacts.
modes.replay_rule: Use /releases/2026-05-31/manifest.json and artifact SHA-256 values for reproducible citations.
modes.privacy_note: No third-party browser request is required for canonical release measurements.

modes.label: Live overlay
modes.trigger: User explicitly selects the live overlay or a runtime context surface that needs current public rows
modes.destination: Documented public-source domains listed in this artifact
modes.cache_policy: Live overlay responses are not canonical release artifacts and must be rematerialized before replacing snapshot rows.
modes.replay_rule: Promote current rows through a release-candidate PR, source-freshness review, and a new release manifest.
modes.privacy_note: Requests are public data lookups scoped to selected place or layer identifiers, not personal data collection.

domains.cache_policy: Release artifacts are immutable once published and are listed in the release manifest.
domains.replay_rule: Replay from committed files, latest/manifest.json, or immutable release manifest checksums.
domains.privacy_note: Same-origin static asset and JSON requests do not require a third-party public-source request.

domains.label: World Bank country indicators
domains.trigger: Canonical release build for frozen indicators; live overlay when current public indicator rows are requested
domains.cache_policy: Frozen snapshot values are committed to release artifacts; current overlay checks follow monthly freshness policy.
domains.replay_rule: Canonical changes require source-freshness review and a new release candidate before publication.
domains.privacy_note: Indicator requests use country and indicator identifiers only; PainMap does not send user ids or typed search strings.

domains.label: Our World in Data livestock and animal production tables
domains.source_vintage: Latest public runtime rows where available; frozen release values dated 2026-05-31.
domains.trigger: Canonical animal-production proxy materialization; optional live overlay for current OWID grapher rows
domains.destination: Our World in Data public grapher CSV endpoints
domains.cache_policy: Release values are frozen; live overlay checks are weekly and non-canonical until rematerialized.
domains.replay_rule: Promote changed proxy rows through release-candidate QA, provenance review, and release diff publication.
domains.privacy_note: Requests identify public grapher datasets and selected place context, not people or personal-health data.

domains.label: geoBoundaries ADM1
domains.source_vintage: Runtime current ADM1 API, converted to media.githubusercontent.com when needed
domains.trigger: ADM1 boundary discovery when a user requests current subnational boundary context
domains.cache_policy: Runtime metadata is treated as an overlay; canonical boundary behavior must be vendored or partitioned before release.
domains.replay_rule: Freeze boundary source metadata and partitioned outputs into a new manifest before treating them as release material.
domains.privacy_note: Requests use public ISO place identifiers and do not include user ids, precise location, or query strings.

domains.label: geoBoundaries ADM1
domains.source_vintage: Runtime current ADM1 API, converted to media.githubusercontent.com when needed
domains.trigger: Topology download URL returned by the geoBoundaries metadata API
domains.cache_policy: Topology downloads are live overlays unless vendored into a release artifact.
domains.replay_rule: Record the fetched source URL and checksum before promotion into release geometry.
domains.privacy_note: Downloads are public boundary assets keyed by place selection, not personal data.

domains.label: WorldPop population context overlays
domains.trigger: Province context request that computes current WorldPop zonal statistics
domains.cache_policy: Runtime context only; canonical release rows require reviewed materialization before publication.
domains.replay_rule: Capture request geometry, upstream response metadata, and checksum before including values in a future release.
domains.privacy_note: Requests contain public boundary geometry for selected regions, not user location or health information.
